authorization_reference: I will allow longer training; Only the model checkpoint parameter count and peak training RAM must be followed. However, selected optimizer hour must be justified based on evidence. Adjust your plan.
initialization_instruction: Continuing from pre-trained 20k will be infeasible as we have scheduled optimizer. You must run all expreiments from scratch.
superseded_proposal: The unlaunched 20k-checkpoint continuation is replaced by complete fresh 40k experiments.
timing_definition: Sum of synchronized Trainer.update seconds: full augmented forward/backward accumulation, optimizer and EMA; excludes data loading, checkpointing, sampling and process startup.

fid_evidence.limitation: One training seed, sparse checkpoints, evolving consistency curriculum; supports an experiment, not a quality forecast.

s1_duration_plan.comparison_scope: Complete fresh 40k-horizon recipe versus historical EXP-1; not a pure duration-only ablation.
s1_duration_plan.gap_policy: Set total_steps=40000 at initialization; exponential ratio 1 to 1/3200 across the full horizon; retain the numerical minimum gap.
s1_duration_plan.optimizer_policy: Fresh RAdam at fixed learning rate 1e-4; no separate learning-rate scheduler in the inspected trainer.
s1_duration_plan.state_policy: Fresh model, optimizer, EMA, RNG and data state at update zero. Restore a checkpoint only for exact recovery of this same unchanged experiment.
s1_duration_plan.ema_policy: Fresh copy of the initialized model; original global-step warmup starts at zero.
s1_duration_plan.evaluation_reference: Archived EXP-1 20k checkpoint, evaluated only; never loaded as training initialization.

s2_capacity_plan.curriculum: The same complete 40000-update exponential curriculum as S1, set at initialization; no terminal-gap continuation.
s2_capacity_plan.state_policy: Fresh model, optimizer, EMA, RNG and data state at update zero; same optimizer/EMA policies as S1.
s2_capacity_plan.comparison: Matched image presentations and curriculum against S1; report compute separately.
s2_capacity_plan.allocation_reason: Match S1 exposure to test width; throughput and memory must be measured before assigning hours.

s3_deferred_capacity.condition: Allocate only if measured U-Net160 quality/cost or another concrete diagnosis supports further capacity.
